title: Tech Note: Helping Date and Time Data Entry

historical_commentary.text: The specific PDA-style hand-built date/time entry widget described here has been made largely unnecessary by the native date/time picker controls now standard in modern GUI toolkits, browsers, and current 4D form objects, so this note is chiefly of historical interest as a snapshot of pre-native-widget UI engineering in the 4D community.
related_updates: Modern operating systems, browsers, and current 4D form objects provide native date/time pickers, removing the need for this kind of hand-built entry widget
